select distinct tfd.* from Tran_Fee_Def tfd,Tran_Fee tf,Tran tb,Issue_Info ii where tfd.feeTypeID=tf.feeTypeID and tf.tanum=tb.tanum and tb.cusip=ii.cusip and tb.portfolio=#{portID} and tb.lotnum=#{lotnum} and ii.securityid=#{secid}
select distinct tm.assetType from Tran_Fee_Def def, Tran_Fee_TypeMap tm where def.feeTypeID=tm.tranFeeTypeCode and def.oneTimeFeeFlag=1 and def.status=1
